name: eliot-governor
description: LEGACY COMPATIBILITY FIXTURE (#18): exposes the eliot-governor facade to Claude Desktop pending migration to bins/eliot-agent-bridge. Not the production Governor.
long_description: COMPATIBILITY FIXTURE, issue #18 (Claude Desktop MCPB server entry point). Reads current task truth, expands exact evidence, uses governed memory, delegates bounded work, and submits receipted candidate or verification results through the legacy eliot-governor facade only. Serving already reaches bins/eliot-agent-bridge + crates/surfaces/* through the facade's unconditional Bridge redirect (default-profile mcp stdio never reaches facade serving; no Governor, Store, WAL, or writer object is constructed on this path). The packaged launch still names the facade shim pending the three out-of-lane prerequisites recorded in _legacy_compatibility (current-owner catalog authority, installation-owned declaration provisioning into the extension dir, host CLI migration); replicating facade --host/--instance argv in the Bridge is not the remedy (I7.6 forbids host-specific semantic forks; bridge protocol owned by #77). eliot-claude-sidecar is unavailable-target per integrations/claude/route-profile.json. Remove when the packaged server entry point is a current root binary under #11. Claude identity never grants a permanent role.

_legacy_compatibility.consumer: Claude Desktop MCPB server entry point
_legacy_compatibility.missing_protocol: packaged launch of the current-owner server: entry_point/command/args still invoke the facade redirect shim, not eliot-agent-bridge with native mcp --profile/--transport/--client-declaration argv
_legacy_compatibility.owner_gap: serving already reaches the admitted owner (facade entry gate redirects default-profile mcp stdio to the Bridge SPINE_FUNCTIONAL contour with no Governor/Store/WAL construction; crates/eliot-app/src/main.rs::delegate_host_mcp_to_agent_bridge, #18 W11). Launch migration needs three out-of-lane prerequisites, none of which is replicating facade --host/--instance argv in the Bridge (host-specific semantic forks are forbidden by I7.6; bridge protocol owned by #77): (1) current-owner catalog authority for the MCPB build (packaged tools/prompts are generated by `eliot-governor mcp catalog` under crates/eliot-app/src/mcp_stdio/catalog_parity_tests.rs; the Bridge serves the generated canonical eliot-mcp tool surface and no prompts); (2) installation-owned agent-bridge/client-declaration-v2.json provisioning into the Claude-owned extension dir (bridge hard-requires it absolute per bins/eliot-agent-bridge/src/cli_contract.rs; no installer targets that dir; owner #11); (3) host install/activate/doctor CLI migration to bins/eliot (W11; owner #11). eliot-claude-sidecar is unavailable-target (integrations/claude/route-profile.json)
_legacy_compatibility.serving: delegated: this edge never reaches facade serving (the entry gate redirects delegated hosts and rejects all others before mcp_stdio::run); stderr REDIRECT receipt, stdio session handed to the Bridge child, resolution/launch failures fail closed with no legacy fallback
_legacy_compatibility.expiry: remove when the packaged server entry point is a current root binary under #11
